title: FIGHTING DUNGEON
description: This is a mod focused on combat and exploration, but it’s really difficult, so think carefully before trying it (though I know you’re strong enough for it anyway) =)
body:
⚔️ Welcome to the Ultimate Combat Experience!

A high-octane, Fabric-based modpack designed for players who crave intense action, strategic combat, and endless exploration. Built on **Minecraft 1.20.1**, this pack transforms the vanilla experience into a battlefield where preparation is key and every encounter is a challenge.

🎯 **Core Experience**

• **Pure Combat Focus:** Engineered entirely around action-packed mechanics. Prepare for fast-paced PvP/PvE encounters that test your skills.

• **Solo vs. Multiplayer:** Designed for maximum fun with friends, but offers a brutal, survival-horror challenge for solo players. The night is not safe!

• **Endless Exploration:** Discover uncharted biomes, conquer sprawling dungeons, and face epic bosses that guard massive loot.

⚙️ **What's Inside?**

• **Massive Arsenal:** Over 50 new weapons, tools, and armor sets to master.

• **Dangerous Mobs:** Beware of swarming enemies—and never, ever underestimate the "baby" mobs. They are deadlier than you think!

• **Optimized Performance:** Built on the lightweight Fabric modloader for a smooth, high-FPS experience even with heavy combat mods.

📦 **Technical Details**

• **Modloader:** Fabric

• **Version:** 1.20.1

🚀 **How to Install**

1. Use the Modrinth App

2. Search for "FIGHTING DUNGEON".

3. Install and dive into the chaos!

Join the fight today—victory goes to the brave!
